semantics:
- main:
  - heading "QA plain host" [level=1]
  - paragraph:
    - text: Readable host text with
    - link "a real link":
      - /url: "#after"
    - text: .
  - button "Host action before widget"
  - button "Host action after widget"
- status: Focus highlight On
- button "Open accessibility options" [expanded]
- dialog "Accessibility options":
  - heading "Accessibility options" [level=2]
  - button "Close"
  - paragraph: Choose settings for this page.
  - region "Content":
    - heading "Content" [level=3]
    - heading "Font size" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Scale text, including pixel-sized text.
    - text: 90 percent
    - group "Font size":
      - button "Decrease Font size": Decrease
      - button "Increase Font size": Increase
    - heading "Line height" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Set line spacing and paragraph gaps.
    - radiogroup "Line height":
      - radio "Off"
      - text: "Off"
      - radio "1.5" [checked]
      - text: "1.5"
      - radio "1.75"
      - text: "1.75"
      - radio "2"
      - text: "2"
    - heading "Letter spacing" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Add space between letters.
    - radiogroup "Letter spacing":
      - radio "Off"
      - text: "Off"
      - radio "0.12em" [checked]
      - text: 0.12em
      - radio "0.16em"
      - text: 0.16em
      - radio "0.2em"
      - text: 0.2em
    - heading "Word spacing" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Add space between words.
    - radiogroup "Word spacing":
      - radio "Off"
      - text: "Off"
      - radio "0.16em" [checked]
      - text: 0.16em
      - radio "0.24em"
      - text: 0.24em
      - radio "0.32em"
      - text: 0.32em
    - heading "Text alignment" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Align text blocks without moving layout controls.
    - radiogroup "Text alignment":
      - radio "Off"
      - text: "Off"
      - radio "Left" [checked]
      - text: Left
      - radio "Center"
      - text: Center
      - radio "Right"
      - text: Right
    - heading "Content scale" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Scale the whole page layout.
    - text: 110 percent
    - group "Content scale":
      - button "Decrease Content scale": Decrease
      - button "Increase Content scale": Increase
    - heading "Readable font" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Use a system font or a preloaded owner font.
    - radiogroup "Readable font":
      - radio "Off"
      - text: "Off"
      - radio "Readable" [checked]
      - text: Readable
      - radio "Dyslexia-friendly"
      - text: Dyslexia-friendly
  - region "Colour and contrast":
    - heading "Colour and contrast" [level=3]
    - heading "Dark mode" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Use dark surfaces and light text; preserve media colours.
    - button "Dark mode" [pressed]
    - heading "High contrast" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Use black surfaces, white text and yellow links.
    - button "High contrast" [pressed]
    - heading "Monochrome" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Remove colour from text, backgrounds and supported media.
    - button "Monochrome" [pressed]
    - heading "Low saturation" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Reduce colour intensity; monochrome takes priority.
    - button "Low saturation" [pressed]
  - region "Navigation and orientation":
    - heading "Navigation and orientation" [level=3]
    - heading "Reading guide" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Follow the mouse, touch point or keyboard focus.
    - button "Reading guide" [pressed]
    - heading "Reading mask" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Gently dim outside the pointer or keyboard-focus strip.
    - button "Reading mask" [pressed]
    - heading "Highlight links" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Outline and underline links, including custom link controls.
    - button "Highlight links" [pressed]
    - heading "Highlight headings" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Outline headings and show a small heading-level badge.
    - button "Highlight headings" [pressed]
    - heading "Larger cursor" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Choose a larger pointer for a mouse or trackpad.
    - paragraph: Larger cursors need a mouse or trackpad and are paused while system colours are active.
    - radiogroup "Larger cursor":
      - radio "Off"
      - text: "Off"
      - radio "Large" [checked]
      - text: Large
      - radio "Extra large"
      - text: Extra large
    - heading "Stop animations" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Pause CSS animation and autoplay video; disable transitions and smooth scrolling.
    - button "Stop animations" [pressed]
    - heading "Focus highlight" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Show a two-tone keyboard focus ring and avoid top-edge headers.
    - button "Focus highlight" [pressed]
  - button "Reset all"
